concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished original logo concept for the existing project "FDR Sentinel", a portal for institutional security deposit/FDR records, document evidence and independent clearance workflows. Direction A: GUARDIAN LEDGER. Design a distinctive compact geometric shield silhouette with a subtle document/ledger and negative-space letter F integrated into one simple coherent mark. Confident, restrained, trustworthy, contemporary institutional software branding. Flat vector-like geometry, clean optical proportions, strong silhouette readable at favicon size, at most two inks: deep navy #142A48 and cobalt #255BCE. Center the symbol above a beautifully spaced professional sans-serif wordmark. Exact wordmark text: "FDR Sentinel". White background, square composition, abundant clean space, large clear logo suitable for concept comparison. No additional text or tagline, no mockup objects, no photographic textures, no gradients, shadows, embossing, stock clipart, currency coins, government insignia or official seals. This is an original independent student project identity, not a government logo. Deliver one logo lockup, not a grid.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished original logo concept for "FDR Sentinel", software connecting institutional security deposit records, evidence, scrutiny and independent bureau clearances. Direction B: CONNECTED SENTINEL. A distinctive abstract capital S symbol made from three broad linked geometric segments / interlocking bands, suggesting a continuous documented lifecycle and coordinated independent stages. Keep the silhouette bold and simple enough for a 24px app icon; no tiny nodes, circuits or thin network lines. Elegant modern institutional SaaS identity, precise balanced proportions. Flat vector-like design using deep navy #142A48, cobalt #255BCE, with a very restrained teal accent if needed. Center the large symbol above the exact wordmark "FDR Sentinel" in beautifully spaced modern sans serif. Plain white background, square composition and ample space. One logo only. No other text, no slogans, no 3D, gradients, shadows, coins, padlocks, government insignia or official seals. It should feel distinct from a generic cybersecurity shield.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished original logo concept for "FDR Sentinel", an institutional deposit management and evidence review platform. Direction C: SENTINEL MONOGRAM. Create a custom architectural FS monogram: two or three substantial geometric strokes integrate an F and flowing S through clever negative space, suggesting an upright guardian/watchtower and ordered document layers. Premium typographic identity, restrained and intelligent, with a compact unmistakable mark that works in one ink at favicon size. Avoid literal eyes, people, towers with windows or complicated illustrations. Flat vector-like geometry. Deep navy #142A48 as dominant ink and cobalt #255BCE accent. Center the symbol over the exact text "FDR Sentinel" in a refined legible sans-serif wordmark. Plain white square canvas, generous whitespace, crisp edges, careful alignment, large clear logo. One concept lockup, not a board. No extra text, no slogans, no 3D, no gradients, shadows, coins, generic checkmarks, government insignia or official seals.
